snippet.title: Banana Ranch 18+ BL / Yaoi game: Get to know more about Banana Ranch!
snippet.description:
FREE DEMO AVAILABLE!
Download link: meyaoi.itch.io/bananaranch

What is Banana Ranch?

Banana Ranch is a 18+ dating sim + ranch management game involving romance between two men (MxM / BL / Yaoi / Gay). It’s a fully reversible game, which means all characters can be TOP and BOTTOM! Our protagonist is a country boy who decided to move to Banana Town. However, strange things happened during his way to Banana Town, and he was suddenly transported to a different world. The town he arrived at was still called Banana Town, but all the town citizens have somehow transformed into humanoid animals. Moreover, the ranch he was going to work at was not hiring at all, it was even on the verge of bankruptcy!

The game will involve three years of Ban’s life at Banana Town. As the player, you’re in charge of shaping Ban’s destiny! How will you spend Ban’s days? Can Ban save Banana Ranch from the verge of bankruptcy? Will Ban be in a relationship with one of the eligible bachelors? Who will you marry and have kids with? Will you make Ban be the TOP or BOTTOM in the relationship? It’s all in your hand! 

-- GAME FEATURES -- 

REVERSIBLE ROLE
Like in my previous game Seiyuu Danshi, in this game you can be either top or bottom in the relationship! What is your preference, to be fucked or fuck your guy? Well, it's all your choice! 

FOREPLAY MODE 
Tired of the usual inactivity during sex in other games? In this  game, you get to touch & kiss your sex partner as much as you want! Woo-hoo! 

MARRIAGE & KIDS
What happens after you manage to woo your favorite guy? Will the game just end like that? Nope. In the world of Banana Ranch, gay marriage is 100% legal and you can marry your boyfriend and even have kids with him! (How? Well, play the game to find out ;))

RANCH MANAGEMENT
In the world of Banana Ranch, ranch animals are basically employed workers who get paid monthly to produce dairy products. Recruit more ranch animals & negotiate wage with them to gain maximum profit and rescue your ranch from the brink of bankruptcy!

WEEKEND DATING
 Go on a date with your favorite guy during the weekend to various places in town . Talk to him on various topics, touch him anywhere you want, and give him meaningful gifts that he can wear later on!

DRESS UP SYSTEM
Purchase & design outfits to your liking and spend your days hanging out in town looking all stylish!

NPC QUEST SYSTEM
NPCs play a very important part in the world of Banana Ranch! NPCs give interesting quests with rewards that you definitely can't miss out! (Psst, if you want, you can become one of the NPCs in the game!)

ENHANCED GIFTING MECHANISM
In this game, you can gift clothes / accessories to a character & he will actually add the items to his wardrobe for him to wear!
